nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Retinol Serum

segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes her skin as sensitive, oily, and acne-prone reports the serum leaves no greasy residue and soaks in smoothly.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, several of whom also describe it as sensitive, report the serum is noticeably hydrating, especially helpful with winter dryness, and easier to tolerate than the prescription-strength retinols some had tried before.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports a pleasant texture with no stinging, and another suggests the serum's hydrating, low-retinol formula suits dry or combination skin well.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is the most frequently mentioned segment, with the large majority of reviewers reporting no irritation, redness, or peeling despite it being a retinol, several specifically recommending it as a gentle starting point for sensitive or first-time retinol users, though some note the trade-off is a mild concentration that may be less potent than they'd like.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 60s reports her fine lines becoming less noticeable with use, and another notes the formula works for mature skin too, though both add it is gentler and less potent than a prescription retinoid.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, improved firmness, and smoother, more even texture after several weeks of consistent use, including specific improvement on forehead lines, smile lines, and crow's feet. Dissent exists: one reviewer with already-minimal lines saw no change, one cautions it is not a solution for deep wrinkles, and one reports the product severely damaged her skin (acne, redness, texture) after five months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating rather than drying, including several with dry skin who saw notable improvement, and many say it kept their skin comfortable even used nightly. A minority dissent: one had mild dryness alongside otherwise good results, one found it dried and peeled the skin specifically around the eyes, and a few recommend layering a night cream on top to fully prevent dryness.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including some with rosacea or nose-area redness, report the serum reduced existing redness or caused none at all; one with rosacea felt briefly flushed and itchy right after application before it settled within minutes, and one reviewer's redness worsened significantly after five months of use.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers specifically credit the serum with helping repair or restore their skin barrier, alongside improved hydration.
concerns.spots: The reviewer tracking post-blemish dark marks from perimenopausal breakouts reports the serum helped them begin to fade relatively quickly, though she notes more consistent sunscreen use would likely improve results further.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal breakouts report fewer or less severe blemishes with regular use, including one whose persistent hormonal acne became noticeably less frequent and less severe. One reviewer is a strong outlier, reporting the serum caused new, severe acne after five months of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found the serum absorbed fully with no greasy residue, while another describes the opposite experience: the product stayed moist and oily-feeling on her skin for over an hour without ever fully drying down.

aspects.libelle: Well-designed pump bottle, easy to dispense
Good value for the amount of product
Mild transient tingling or purging when starting

extraits.texte: I tried this for about 5 months hoping the initial purging would go away and my skin would end up okay. It ruined my skin and gave me awful acne, redness, and textured skin which I am still working to get rid of 6 months later.

I was so hoping to love this product! I have never tried this brand before but I have heard a lot about it. The packaging is great. The bottle itself is heavy and nice. The pump works well and pumps out the right amount. The consistency of the product is great and is easy to apply. There isn't really any scent to the prodcut. The issue I have, is the product never seems to dry. Even over an hour later my face was moist and almost oily. I have never experienced a product like this. I was afraid the product was going to transfer to surfaces I would touch so I eventually had to wash my face to remove it. The product has almost an oily feel to it when you apply it. It is difficult to describe but I definitely don't recommend it.

extraits.titre: Gentle for Roseca-with smooth results and minimal
extraits.texte: Finding a retinol that works with permanent rosacea is a journey, but I'm impressed with this Fab retinol serum. I followed a specific routine using a cream cleanser, mild hydrating toner, the retinol serum ,hydrating essence, eye cream, and a heavier moisturizer thinned out with essence. In the serum photo the texture is creamy, lightweight, and non-greasy. (After skin care P1 )shows my skin right after the final step; it felt flushed and hot for a small amount of time with some mild itchiness. In (After Skincare P2) about 5 minutes later ,the reaction settled as it was absorbed. The next day photo shows the results: my skin is incredibly smooth, though I do have some mild dryness I also had some very mild purging with a few tiny, barely noticeable blemishes on the cheek that weren't painful or inflamed. I only use this at night and always follow up with a sensitive sunscreen during the day to protect the progress it's effective yet general enough for those who usually have to be careful with retinol's and my skin feels incredibly soft and not irritated.

extraits.titre: Luxurious, hydrating with a glowing effect
extraits.texte: I had the opportunity to try the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Retinol Serum. I used it consistently for about 2 weeks and I really loved it. My skin tends to be very dry, especially in the winter and this serum helped a lot with hydration. It contains a very low percentage of retinol, which should be tolerable for any skin type. I had no skin sensitivity or irritation while using it. The serum has a luxurious, hydrating and has this glowing effect. It really helped to prep my skin along with my moisturizer. In my opinion, it will be best for dry or combination type skin. I really enjoyed it and it will be perfect for the retinol first-timers, since the concentration is very gentle. Thank you Influenster and First Aid Beauty for sending me this retinol serum in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have seen a change in my skin during perimenopause, with blemishes (and subsequent dark marks) approximately a week after my period. This cream has helped those marks begin to fade relatively quickly. Admittedly, I need to improve on my sunscreen use, because I'm sure I'd see much better impact. I did not have additional skin issues using this products. It seemed to be very gentle. I would continue to use this!

I have combination, acne prone skin. I love the ultra repair series and was excited to try this retinol serum out. The packaging is nice, with the squeezer being easy to use, and gets out a good amount of product. The serum, as far as I could tell, was fragrance free. It had a nice consistency and absorbed easily onto my skin. No stinging or anything like that.

I love this stuff. Its smooth going on and makes my face soft. My skin drinks it in and it doesn't take very long. My lines are becoming less noticeable & although I know they won't disapear entirely, I'm starting to look better. Not bad for a 60 year old. Definitely recommend.
